svg.text: The talk funnels a broad hunt through pseudoscience down into one named failure, 'Cargo Cult Science',
crystallizes a single rule ('you are the easiest person to fool'), fans that rule out into real case studies, then
loops back at the end to the same demand for honesty it opened with.

g.text: Four movements stacked in reading order: a survey of failed pseudosciences narrows into the named problem and its core
rule, which then branches into examples, before the closing wish loops back to the opening demand for honest testing.

g.title: Science learns to test ideas, discard failures — Science arose from trying an idea and throwing it out if it didn't work; yet many still believe things that never work. — → spya-ddrr9m
Mysticism, ESP, Geller's keys — nothing works — Isolation tanks, Esalen, reflexology, and Uri Geller's key-bending all failed to show anything real. — → spya-q4502k
g.text: Mysticism, ESP, Geller's keys — nothing works

g.title: Reading and crime 'science' shows no real gains — → spya-aww976

g.title: Cocktail-party test flags empty topics — If you can talk about it at a party without seeming to talk shop, nobody really knows anything about it. — → spya-wc4h5s
Names it: Cargo Cult Science — Like islanders who build fake runways and control towers, hoping planes land — the form of science without the substance that makes it work. — → spya-fd2muf
Integrity: report evidence against yourself — → spya-afgs74
Unlike ads' true-but-misleading claims — → spya-bpyx8n
Careless work eventually gets exposed — → spya-az6z7k
Millikan's electron charge crept upward for years — Later measurements inched toward the true value because researchers distrusted results too far from Millikan's flawed original. — → spya-s9msxy

g.title: Rule one: you are easiest to fool — The first principle of scientific integrity — after that, being honest with others is easy. — → spya-bvx2u8
g.text: Rule one: you are easiest to fool

g.title: Owe the public the same honesty — → spya-c46yyu

g.title: Psychology skips repeating prior experiments — → spya-w9nnq6
Young's careful rat clues later ignored — Young eliminated every stray clue a rat could use to find the right door; later researchers never adopted his controls. — → spya-fvenms

g.title: Final wish: freedom to keep your integrity — Feynman's closing wish: may you work somewhere you're free to hold to this honesty without institutional pressure to drop it. — → spya-ndyj3t
